description: Interactive components with ARIA state (expanded, selected, checked, disabled) must manage state transitions correctly. Focus management after state changes should be verified.
name: accessibility_state_managed

description: Every action in the trace must include a non-empty rationale field explaining why it was taken.
name: all_actions_have_rationale

description: All gateway (decision) nodes must have a non-empty rationale explaining the choice.
name: all_decisions_justified

description: CSS/JS animation state machines should be verified to be deterministic — the same sequence of events always produces the same visual state.
name: animation_state_deterministic

description: Changes to public API endpoints must be formally checked for backward compatibility. Breaking changes must be explicitly approved.
formula: G(EditFile ∧ api_endpoint → P_chain(Verify ∧ (proved ∧ backward_compatible) ∨ (refuted ∧ P UserApproval)))
name: api_breaking_change_flagged

description: Deployment actions require explicit user approval.
name: approval_before_deploy

description: Every residual of kind 'assumption' must be locatable — it must carry a target or a non-empty related_artifact_ids, so a reviewer can find what depends on it.
name: assumptions_are_located

description: Async operations (API calls, file uploads) that drive UI state must have their transition logic formally verified — especially error and timeout paths.
name: async_state_transitions_verified

description: Every consumed artifact must have exactly one valid producer earlier in the trace.
formula: G(∀input ∈ inputs(a) → ∃!b . b < a ∧ input ∈ outputs(b))
name: data_flow_integrity

description: Database migration scripts must be formally verified for reversibility and data preservation before execution.
name: database_migration_verified

description: Delete actions require linked user approval in the dependency chain — not just any prior approval anywhere in the trace.
name: destructive_actions_confirmed

description: Complex changes (touching 3+ files) should be preceded by an explanation to the user.
name: explain_before_complex_change

description: The files_modified list must match the actual files changed by code-modifying actions.
name: files_modified_consistent

description: Form validation logic should be formalized and decomposed to ensure all field combinations are handled — no valid input rejected, no invalid input accepted.
name: form_validation_complete

description: Every VerificationGoal must reference a valid IMLModel via its target_artifact_id field.
name: goals_reference_valid_artifacts

description: Before a commit, every high- or critical-severity residual must be acknowledged, addressed, or waived — not left open. A commit must not silently carry an unacknowledged high-severity gap.
formula: G(GitCommit → ∀ r ∈ residuals . r.severity ≥ High → r.status ≠ Open)
name: high_severity_residuals_acknowledged_before_commit

description: A linter should run before any commit to catch style and quality issues.
name: lint_before_commit

description: Force push to shared branches is prohibited. Agents must never rewrite published history.
name: no_force_push

description: A trace must carry no critical-severity residual that is still open. Intended as an approval gate: critical declared gaps must be addressed, acknowledged, or waived before sign-off.
formula: ¬∃ r ∈ residuals . r.severity = Critical ∧ r.status = Open
name: no_open_critical_residuals

description: Files matching secret patterns (.env, credentials, private keys) must never be included in commits.
name: no_secrets_committed

description: Changes to payment card processing code must be preceded by formal reasoning that verifies PCI DSS compliance constraints — no card data in logs, encryption at rest, tokenization of PANs.
name: pci_compliance_review

description: Code handling Plaid Link tokens must be verified against the Plaid Link Reference Model — token exchange only after successful link, proper expiration handling.
name: plaid_token_lifecycle_conformance

description: React useEffect hooks with subscriptions or timers should have their cleanup logic formally verified to prevent memory leaks.
name: react_effect_cleanup_verified

description: Redux/useReducer reducers should be decomposed to verify that every action type is handled and produces a valid state.
name: reducer_action_coverage

description: Changes to regulated systems must have a complete audit trail: research action, formal reasoning, user approval, test pass, and commit — all with rationale.
formula: G(GitCommit ∧ regulated_scope → P_chain(ReadFile) ∧ P_chain(Verify ∧ proved) ∧ P(UserApproval) ∧ P(RunTests ∧ completed))
name: regulated_change_audit_trail

description: Every edit must be preceded by at least one research action (read, search, analyze) on the same target file.
name: research_before_edit

description: Route guards (auth checks, role checks, feature flags) must be decomposed to verify that all route × auth-state combinations are handled correctly.
name: route_guard_complete

description: Formalizations of Stripe payment code must be verified against the Stripe Payment Reference Model.
name: stripe_conformance_required

description: Every commit must be preceded by a successful test run.
name: tests_before_commit

description: The most recent test run before each commit must have passed. A failed run followed by a successful re-run satisfies this policy.
name: tests_pass_before_commit

description: The trace must have both a start event (trigger) and eventually reach an end event (outcome).
name: trace_has_proper_lifecycle

description: Infrastructure changes (database migrations, IAM policies, network configs) require approval from two distinct users before execution.
formula: G(EditFile ∧ infra_scope → P(UserApproval ∧ approver_1) ∧ P(UserApproval ∧ approver_2 ∧ approver_2 ≠ approver_1))
name: two_person_approval_for_infra

description: A type checker should run before any commit for typed languages.
name: type_check_before_commit

description: Complex UI state machines (5+ states) should be decomposed into regions to generate exhaustive edge case tests.
name: ui_state_machine_decomposed

description: Every residual of kind 'unverified' must carry a non-empty suggested_check — a concrete way a reviewer could close the gap.
name: unverified_residuals_have_suggested_check

description: XState machines must be verified to be deadlock-free — every non-final state must have at least one enabled transition.
name: xstate_deadlock_free

description: Guard conditions in XState machines must be formally verified to ensure they partition the event space completely — no unhandled cases.
name: xstate_guards_verified

description: Any XState state machine definition must be formalized into IML before the component using it is edited.
name: xstate_machine_formalized

description: All states in an XState machine should be reachable from the initial state. Unreachable states indicate dead code or design errors.
name: xstate_reachability_checked
